environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 instance. MODEL_SIGNING_KEY is set via environment variable at container start and remains static for the lifetime of the deployment (typically days/weeks). Token authentication credentials are long-lived API keys stored in DynamoDB. No network segmentation between API and internal services.

config.key_rotation: none - static env var set at deploy time
config.MODEL_SIGNING_KEY: static value loaded once from Parameter Store at boot
